project_type: Greenfield Python 3.12 monorepo (single uv project 'ossbot') + bash provisioning/entrypoints + PowerShell 5.1 host scripts + systemd units + Dockerfiles, running inside the dedicated WSL2 distro 'ossbot' on Windows 11. Components: gatekeeper (FastAPI over UDS, SQLite, Telegram bot), runner, sandboxd, dockerfilter (root), watchdog (root), ossctl (typer), sandbox_tools (stdlib, baked into images), vendored Hermes Kiro ACP provider fork.
build_system: uv 0.13.x (pinned binary at /opt/ossbot/bin/uv inside the distro, installed by provision.sh step 'uv'), pyproject.toml + uv.lock, all installs '--frozen'. Dev venv on ext4 via UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT (/home/ossadmin/.venvs/ossbot, root: /root/.venvs/ossbot), never in the repo. Deployed runtime: provision.sh 'app deploy' rsyncs src/ pyproject.toml uv.lock prompts/ vendor/ to /opt/ossbot/app and runs 'uv sync --frozen --no-dev' (venv /opt/ossbot/app/.venv). The repo is on drvfs at /mnt/d/Work/autonomous-oss-contributor (same path before and after the fstab confinement). Quirk: Windows git has core.autocrlf=true, so .gitattributes (LF everywhere, CRLF for *.ps1) must land first (PLAN item 1).
test_framework: pytest + pytest-asyncio + respx + hypothesis; markers: unit (default, no Docker/network), telegram, acp, e2e (FakeRuntime), e2e_docker, sandbox (Docker + images, root), system (root-run probes on the provisioned distro), isolation (from Windows). Shell system tests under tests/system/*.sh run as root. Windows-side tests: scripts/test-isolation.ps1, tests/system/test_kill.ps1, tests/system/test_bootstrap_zero.ps1 (test distro name only).
build_command: From Windows PowerShell in d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor. Provision: powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\bootstrap.ps1 (streams scripts/provision.sh over stdin as root). Partial provision during development: (Get-Content -Raw scripts/provision.sh) -replace "`r","" | wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root -- bash -s -- --only <steps>. Lock/sync dev env: wsl.exe -d ossbot -u ossadmin --cd /mnt/d/Work/autonomous-oss-contributor --exec /usr/bin/env UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/home/ossadmin/.venvs/ossbot /opt/ossbot/bin/uv sync --frozen (use 'uv lock' only when changing dependencies).
test_command: DEV = wsl.exe -d ossbot -u ossadmin --cd /mnt/d/Work/autonomous-oss-contributor --exec /usr/bin/env UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/home/ossadmin/.venvs/ossbot /opt/ossbot/bin/uv run --frozen ; then: DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram or acp or e2e" ; DEV ruff check src tests ; DEV ruff format --check src tests ; DEV mypy ; DEV lint-imports. Root markers: ROOTDEV = wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root --cd /mnt/d/Work/autonomous-oss-contributor --exec /usr/bin/env UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/root/.venvs/ossbot /opt/ossbot/bin/uv run --frozen ; ROOTDEV pytest -m sandbox. Shell/system: ROOT = wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root --cd /mnt/d/Work/autonomous-oss-contributor --exec ; ROOT bash tests/system/<name>.sh ; ROOT shellcheck <files>.
verification_instructions: 1) Read docs/PLAN.md 'Conventions', 'Decisions' and 'Required overall verification', then the FEAT file. 2) Before writing code that depends on a DESIGN §23 [VERIFY] item, check it by web search or live probe and record the result in config/versions.lock.yaml or an 'Implementation addendum' at the end of the named ADR; items needing a real key are recorded as 'pending live probe (needs <secret>)' and reported by ossctl doctor as AWAITING SECRET. 3) Run the FEAT's verification commands from Windows using the DEV/ROOTDEV/ROOT prefixes (wsl.exe --exec passes PowerShell-quoted args intact; never use wsl -- bash -c "..." with embedded quotes; multi-line scripts go via stdin with CR stripped). 4) Lint gate on every Python change: ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy (strict for ossbot.gatekeeper, ossbot.dockerfilter, ossbot.common), lint-imports; shellcheck on every changed .sh. 5) Phase-level bars: docs/PLAN.md sections '### Phase 1 verification' and '### Phase 2 verification'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Checked in and regenerated by commands: uv.lock (uv lock), config/versions.lock.yaml (provision 'images' step writes image digests; versions/sha256 pins edited by hand after web verification), tests/unit/dockerfilter/corpus/*.json (re-recorded from the pinned Docker CLI in FEAT-004), tests/telegram/golden/* (golden card snapshots), README command table (ossctl docs commands; CI checks with --check). Never committed: config/profile.yaml (gitignored, owner values), .ossbot-local/, .wsl/, backups/, tools/bin/.
environment_constraints: Windows 11 laptop, PowerShell 5.1 shell. WSL 3.0.3.0, kernel 6.18.54.1-1. Distro 'ossbot' (Ubuntu 24.04.5, systemd on, VHD at d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor\.wsl\ossbot) already exists; at planning time it is unprovisioned: automount on (/mnt/c visible), interop on, no uid 1000 user, Python 3.12.3 + git 2.43.0 only. WSL is used ONLY for ossbot: wsl --shutdown / --terminate ossbot are allowed. Never unregister or delete the distro or its VHD; never touch .wsl\. The only files allowed outside the repo: %USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig (from config/wsl/wslconfig, existing file backed up to .ossbot-local\), Scheduled Task 'ossbot-autostart', optional Hyper-V firewall rules (only if the session is already elevated; never trigger UAC). After FEAT-004: plain 'wsl.exe -d ossbot' lands as ossnobody, so always pass -u ossadmin or -u root; /mnt/c is gone; Linux cannot run Windows exes (Windows->Linux wsl.exe still works); ossadmin and root have unrestricted egress, service uids only via squid ports. No real secrets exist (Kiro keys, Telegram token/user id, GitHub PATs): everything must be testable with fakes; live checks belong in ossctl doctor. Docker image builds (sandbox-full) can take 20-40 min: use long timeouts or run in background. Git: commit with Windows git only; before every commit run Remove-Item Env:GIT_AUTHOR_NAME,Env:GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL,Env:GIT_COMMITTER_NAME,Env:GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue and confirm 'git -C d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor var GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT' starts with 'Amsal Khan <md.amsalkhan@gmail.com>'. Never push, pull, fetch, add remotes, change git config of this repo, or rewrite history. Never set GIT_* identity env vars.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING yet (written in FEAT-008). Binding rules from DESIGN.md: invariants I1-I13 (§8.3) are non-negotiable; only gatekeeper/submit.py may import gatekeeper/github_writer.py; runner/sandboxd/sandbox_tools/Hermes plugin never import gatekeeper; argv lists only, never shell=True; pydantic extra=forbid on every external model; LLM output is data parsed through schemas; no personal values or secrets in tracked files outside docs/ (owner values only in gitignored config/profile.yaml; code reads them from the config snapshot; tests use tests/fixtures/profile.test.yaml); never overwrite pre-existing .kiro/ files; Conventional Commits; ADR addendum for every verified fact or decision change. Dev agents must never read /etc/ossbot/secrets/**, never touch /srv/ossbot/gatekeeper/** or /var/lib/ossbot/control/** except through documented scripts/tests, never edit %USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig directly.
key_patterns: Deterministic safety code with exhaustive parametrized tests (state machine ALLOWED table with actors W/G/H; approval binding = sha256(canonical_json) over per-kind fields + dry_run + policy_hash, recomputed at Approve/Confirm/before first write; control_checkpoint() before every GitHub write). Fail closed everywhere (unparseable kill flag = full; missing firewall rules = unit does not start; unverifiable Hermes surface = kill). Root helpers and bash scripts in scripts/bin are self-contained. Fixed templates: sandboxd builds docker argv from fixed per-profile templates, the Docker filter independently re-validates every create body. Gatekeeper git always uses GIT_ENV/GIT_ARGS (protocol.file.allow=never) except the two bundle fetches with BUNDLE_FETCH_ARGS. Single source constants shared across layers (ossbot.common.gitcmd FORMAT_PATCH/NUMSTAT baked into images; stage/entrypoint list shared by runner, sandboxd and test_control.py). Config security files (policy/targets/egress/profile) only via the gatekeeper config snapshot; models.yaml is the only live-read file. Idempotent provision steps printing changed/unchanged.
